author: TeIq
content: **Pre-flight (architect, rust-quality applied).** Extend rotation.rs::step_write_new_key_material with CustodyMode dispatch. (1) passphrase_sealed: reuse PassphraseSealedSigner::write_sealed helper to write the new keypair sealed at the configured path. (2) os_keychain: keyring::Entry::new + set_password with hex-encoded new secret. (3) cloud_kms_oracle: AWS KMS generate_data_key_pair → create alias pointing at new key ID → atomic-swap config to new key_id (alias swap is the rotation primitive). Each mode adds a unit test for its write path. State machine unchanged. CustodyMode enum gets per-variant write impl.
